title: Give OLY-8-05 a mechanism: the critic's adversarial challenge
summary: Ares is the adversarial-challenge role, which maps to the critic stage (critic_round in run/planning.rs; critique records). I read this as asserting that mechanism in docs/spec.toml, adding a test that fails if the critic stops searching for counterexamples, and setting the measure to an existing `athena status` line.

defaults_applied.how: New test plus cargo test and clippy criteria
Criterion runs a test that fails without the mechanism
Reuses the existing critic stage instead of building a new role
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs (critic_round, planning_round, end_round: the critic runs after each planner round and its verdict and findings are written as critique records), crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs (first_round_accepted derives accepted/stopped from critique records; this feeds the `status: planning` line) and crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs (critic brief). Records validation: no new record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not touched.
Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs, crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs and docs/spec.toml are extended, not created.
Goal: the spec owner (Ares) and spec reviewers can see a real mechanism and measure for OLY-8-05. The 'Ares' role is realised by the critic stage; no new role is created.
The measure reuses the existing line `status: planning` (first-round accepted vs stopped, i.e. conclusions challenged and overturned) rather than adding a new status line.

The new test is a unit test in crates/athena-context (critic brief must instruct the critic to look for counterexamples, fragile assumptions and failure modes) and/or in athena-core run tests (a fake critic reject yields a stopped critique record). It fails if that critic instruction or the record is removed.
Consumers: none found; athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows are not changed.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-8-05 has mechanism naming an existing path (crates/athena-core/src/run/planning.rs critic_round and the critic brief in crates/athena-context/src/briefs/planner.rs) instead of "none", keeps owner = "Ares", and its measure ends with `status: planning`; Grep confirms the paths exist.

A new test asserting the critic stage challenges the plan (critic brief demands counterexamples/fragile assumptions/failure modes and a rejecting critic produces a stopped critique record) passes under `cargo test`, and fails when the mechanism code or brief text is removed.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` all pass.
Only docs/spec.toml and files under crates/ change; no governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) changes.

out_of_scope: Creating a new Ares role or prompt
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
